approval.cost: No listing fee or review fee is stated anywhere in the docs or Developer Agreement sections read
approval.trigger: Private apps: no review at all; they skip the approval process entirely and can be shared with any Pipedrive company via the unlisted install link once live. (A DRAFT private app 'can be shared with users in the same Pipedrive company' only; it must be live to share cross-company.) Public apps: review is mandatory before Marketplace listing ('Each new public app submitted to the Pipedrive Marketplace has to pass our approval process'). Reviewers test the app end to end; the checklist requires OAuth 2.0 as primary auth, refreshing the access token after its 60-minute lifetime, only necessary scopes (users can only accept or deny all scopes), polished install/uninstall flows, Terms of Service and Privacy Policy pages, a pricing page link, 3-5 listing images, a demo video explaining permission/scope usage, and fully functional test accounts for Pipedrive's team. After approval, apps are 'unlisted from the Marketplace by default'; you publish manually from Developer Hub. Material changes to an approved app must be resubmitted for approval. The developer sandbox is capped at 5 authorized developer users.
approval.wait: Public app reviews 'may take up to 21 business days' (current banner on the approval-process page, attributed to a surge in demand and vacations; no standard/baseline duration is stated elsewhere)

blockers.detail: 'Do pick your app type carefully, as it cannot be changed later on Developer Hub.' Private and public cannot be converted; you'd create a new app (new credentials, users re-install).
blockers.howToClear: Choose private for your own distribution, public only if Marketplace discovery is worth the review; decide before building.
blockers.title: App type is a one-way door

blockers.detail: 'We allow only one callback URL per app.' Tenant and environment routing must be designed around a single callback (e.g. encode routing in state).
blockers.howToClear: Design callback routing (state-based tenancy) around the single URL from the start.
blockers.title: Exactly one callback URL per app

blockers.detail: 'Every user in a company needs to install or set up their own apps and integrations', and users with multiple companies must install per company; the access token is bound to the granting user AND the company they were logged into when authorizing. Consent is all-or-nothing ('accept or deny all scopes'), and deleting your app uninstalls it from all existing customers and removes it from the Marketplace.
blockers.howToClear: Model connections per user per company, keep scopes minimal, and treat app deletion as a destructive, customer-facing event.
blockers.title: Per-user, per-company installs

flavor.recommended: A Private app in the Developer Hub, distributed via its unlisted installation link
flavor.why: The object is an 'app' created in the Developer Hub (inside a Pipedrive developer sandbox account). Saving a draft app issues the client_id and client_secret; only two fields are required to save a draft: app name and OAuth callback URL. Both flavors use the same OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow, with scopes fixed at registration in the 'OAuth & access scopes' tab. A private app 'can be shared with any user/company in Pipedrive via a direct, unlisted installation link' once live, with no approval process. Note: Pipedrive also has a per-user API token, but the approval checklist explicitly penalizes it ('Your app does not collect, store, or unnecessarily use the API token of a user'); OAuth is the sanctioned path.

humanMust: Request a developer sandbox account at developers.pipedrive.com (Pipedrive may refuse or terminate sandbox access at its sole discretion per the Developer Agreement)
Choose the app type at creation and save the draft app in Developer Hub
For public apps: click 'Send to review' with demo video and test accounts, then click 'Publish' after approval
name: Pipedrive
nuances: Token lifetimes: authorization code 5 minutes; access token 60 minutes; refresh token 'will expire if it isn't used in 60 days. Each time refresh_token is used, its expiry date is reset back to 60 days' (the same refresh token is re-issued on refresh with the window extended). If a refresh token does expire, 'the whole installation process needs to be started from the beginning' (user must reinstall).

The token response returns api_domain; API calls go to {COMPANYDOMAIN}.pipedrive.com/api/v1/... with Authorization: Bearer. Store tokens with room to grow: Pipedrive recommends 'a minimum of varchar (768) for storing the tokens' as token length fluctuates.
Scope or name changes on an approved app 'may have to go through the app approval process again'.

Token exchange must happen after the user has created/logged into an account in YOUR app (the docs warn about the ordering during install). Marketplace installs start from the listing; the /authorize redirect step is only needed if you allow installation outside the Marketplace.
prerequisites: A developer sandbox account (requested at developers.pipedrive.com)
App name and OAuth callback URL (the only two fields needed to save a draft and get credentials)

steps.detail: Required to access Developer Hub. Pipedrive may refuse or terminate sandbox access at its sole discretion; the sandbox is capped at 5 authorized developer users.
steps.title: Request a developer sandbox account

steps.detail: Settings > Developer Hub: choose the app type (public or private; it cannot be changed later), enter app name and OAuth callback URL, and save. Saving the draft generates your client_id/client_secret. A draft private app can be shared only within the same company until it is live.
steps.title: Create the app and save a draft

steps.detail: Set scopes in the 'OAuth & access scopes' tab, mapped to the endpoints you'll call; complete the remaining registration tabs (general info, setup/installation, support & legal, review info); required fields are validated when you send the app to review.
steps.title: Set OAuth & access scopes; complete registration

steps.detail: Redirect to oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/authorize (needed for installs outside the Marketplace); the user clicks 'Allow and install' or 'Cancel'; Pipedrive redirects to your callback with code (or error=user_denied). Exchange at POST oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/token (form-urlencoded, HTTP Basic auth with client_id:client_secret, grant_type=authorization_code). Response: access_token, refresh_token, scope, expires_in, api_domain.
steps.title: Implement the OAuth flow

steps.detail: Access tokens expire after 60 minutes; refresh via the token endpoint with grant_type=refresh_token. Keep refresh tokens used at least every 60 days or users must reinstall.
steps.title: Refresh (60-day inactivity window)

steps.detail: Share the unlisted installation link from your own product; no review stands in the way.
steps.title: (Private) Go live and distribute via your link

steps.detail: Click 'Send to review' with a demo video explaining permission/scope usage and key functionality, fully functional test accounts, and an available contact person. Reviews may take up to 21 business days per the current banner. After approval, go to '...' next to the app in Developer Hub and click 'Publish' (approved apps are unlisted by default).
steps.title: (Public only) Send to review, then publish

tagline: Two flavors with the same flow: a Private app skips review entirely and reaches any Pipedrive company through an unlisted install link, while a Public app buys Marketplace discovery with a checklist review that currently warns of up to 21 business days. The app type cannot be changed later.

time.active: ~25 min of Developer Hub setup + ~1-2 hrs of flow code
time.total: Same day for private apps; public listing adds up to 21 business days of review (stated banner)
